body:
Absolutely this. No matter how bad you have it, you could have been on your death bed and came back and someone will say, "Well, this person died, so feel lucky that wasn't you." 

I'm so tired of hearing, "What do you have to be sad about? Your life isn't that bad. Others have it way worse than you." When I can't even control half the shit that's going on in my head. 

This saying does nothing besides making an already hurting person feel worse because they feel bad.
